doctrine_summary: Pixieset is the SNIPED delivery and commerce platform. This document is Pixieset's own Help Center reference, not strategic doctrine. Operational value is real: it maps every functional endpoint, pricing mechanic, and workflow gate that governs how gallery delivery, print commerce, client management, and studio booking behave inside the platform. Use as a system configuration and decision reference, not a philosophy doc.
operating_rules: DOMAIN SETUP: Subdomain (gallery.yourdomain.com) = 1 CNAME record. Root domain (yourdomain.com) = 1 CNAME for www + 2 A records for @. DNS propagation up to 48 hours; SSL certificate up to 24 hours.

IMAGE SPECS: JPEG/PNG up to 100MB, GIF up to 85MB, RAW up to 100MB. Filenames: alphanumeric + dash/underscore only (no spaces, no special chars). Max edge length 10,000px. sRGB color space recommended.

WATERMARKS: Apply to display images only. Never applied to print orders or high-res downloads (original or 3600px). Web-size downloads (640px/1024px/2048px) can carry optional watermark. Watermark file = PNG, min 1600px width, max 5000px. Updating the watermark does NOT auto-apply to existing photos; must re-apply manually.

VIDEO SPECS: MP4, H.264 codec, 8-bit 4:2:0 or below, 1080p/2K or smaller for uploads. Video downloads auto-convert to MP4 up to 2048px on standard plans. 4K downloads available on Pro/Ultimate only. Uploads can be 4K even when downloads are capped at 2048px (asymmetric limit).
LIGHTROOM SYNC: Plugin supports Lightroom 4+ on Mac OS X 10.9+ / Windows 7+. 'Sync Now' refreshes gallery structure only, NOT uploads or deletions. Counter-intuitive: does not behave as a full sync.
COLLECTION SORT: Default = Name A-Z. Options = Date uploaded, Date taken, Filename, Random. Manual drag-drop reordering available per image or batch.

FOLDER STRUCTURE: Folders contain multiple collections. Bulk create via desktop folders (each folder = 1 collection) or CSV pre-creation. Export folder details as CSV for review. Subfolder upload merges contents into 1 collection, not nested.
BULK OPERATIONS: Bulk edit via pencil icon: Design, Favorite, Store settings, Auto-expiry. Apply to selected collections simultaneously.

HOMEPAGE: Enabled by default. Can set global password. Shows public collections only. Sort options: name, date, custom order. Category tags filter collections. Collections can be hidden from homepage while still accessible via direct link.

QUICK SHARE: Separate page from main gallery. Does NOT inherit password, download PIN, or email registration settings. Intended for vendors, collaborators, publications. Generate unique links, track activity, remove/edit anytime.
EMAIL INVITES: Can schedule to future date (subject to auto-expiry if set). Template system available. Can include collection password, download PIN, client exclusive access password.

EMAIL CAMPAIGNS: Require explicit opt-in consent. Checkbox appears at email registration, store checkout, photo/video download, and favorite sign-in. Checkbox cannot be pre-checked. Same contact counted once across collections. Unsubscribe link mandatory in every email (anti-spam compliance). Invalid/cleaned contacts auto-excluded.

MARKUP MAINTENANCE: Pixieset auto-updates print prices to preserve your set markup percentage when lab costs change. Rounds up to nearest dollar by default (adjustable or disableable in Store > Settings).

LAB COLOR CORRECTION: Additional $1.20/item when enabled on WHCC, ProDPI, or Automatic lab. Not available for cards/albums/books. Miller's and Loxley Colour offer free color correction. Mpix and Atkins Pro do not offer it.

ORDER DELAY: Enables photographer review of client album/book designs before fulfillment. Can adjust crops, change spreads, replace photos, update debossing text, edit shipping address. Cost changes require cancel and reorder.
CONTACT AUTOMATION: New inquiry = auto-created as Lead. New booking = auto-created as Client. Lead or Other contact type auto-converts to Client when they book or pay an invoice.

SHIPPING COVERAGE BY LAB: WHCC = USA/Canada/International. Atkins Pro = AU/NZ/International. Loxley Colour = extensive EU coverage. Self-fulfillment requires explicit shipping method configured per destination country.
TAX AUTOMATION: TaxJar partnership auto-calculates US state/county/district taxes based on business address + client shipping address. Manual tax setup required for all non-US stores.
SESSION INTAKE MINIMUM: First name, last name, email required. Phone and address optional. Upgraded plans allow required questionnaire + contract as booking prerequisites.
PAYMENT METHODS: Pixieset Payments (bank transfer, US only), Stripe (card/debit), PayPal Express Checkout, PayPal card/debit, Manual Payment (cash/check/offline).
MOBILE GALLERY APP: Up to 200 images per app. Free plan: 3 apps max. Paid/Suite plans: unlimited apps.
CSV IMPORT PLATFORMS: Bloom.io, Dubsado, Honeybook, Session, Shootproof, Studio Ninja, 17Hats supported. Duplicate emails skipped on import.

EMAIL ATTACHMENT LIMIT: 25MB max per message. Supports docs (doc/docx/pdf/ppt/pptx/rtf/key/numbers/pages/xls/xlsx/csv/txt/html/xml), media (bmp/gif/jpeg/jpg/png/svg/tiff/psd/avi/mkv/mp4/mov/wmv/aac/mp3/ogg/wav), and other (ics/zip/rar/tar).
DELETE IS PERMANENT: No soft-delete, no undo, no recovery archive. Stated explicitly in documentation.
gates: DNS control required to set up custom domains (CNAME/A records).
Stripe or PayPal account required for Store and automatic fulfillment.
Upgraded Client Gallery or Suite subscription required for: subdomain setup, video uploads, 4K downloads, email campaigns.
Album/book customization: client-facing designer tool only; photographer cannot directly edit client-created designs (preview only). Cost changes require cancel and reorder.
Self-fulfillment items in automatic-fulfillment price sheets do not show self-fulfillment shipping methods; use Extra Shipping per-item instead.
Card designer available ONLY for automatic fulfillment price sheets. Australia/New Zealand limited to Atkins Pro single-photo card designs (no designer).

content_ideas: Watermark strategy: which photos need protection vs which benefit from no watermark. Dual-register: unwatermarked for print/high-res (client trust), watermarked for web/social (brand protection).
Folder organization for repeat clients: annual/seasonal structure enabling easy re-booking. Folders as client portals.
Email campaign cadence: seasonal promos, anniversary reminders, review request timing.
Quick Share workflow: internal use (retouchers, designers) vs external (clients, publications, vendors).
Mobile Gallery App as curated sneak-peek layer: 200-image cap positions it as highlight reel, not full archive delivery.
Order Delay as revision control: positioned as design approval before fulfillment, not just mistake correction.
Markup auto-maintenance as competitive moat: auto-margin preservation vs manual pricing management on other platforms.
weird_gold: SYNC NOW does NOT sync uploads or deletions. Gallery structure only. Users expecting a full sync will miss new/deleted files.
Video upload limit (4K supported) and video download limit (2048px on standard plans) are asymmetric. You can upload 4K and only deliver 2048px unless on Pro/Ultimate.
Bulk create via CSV is ideal for pre-event setup (empty collections named in advance before the shoot happens).
Email campaign opt-in checkbox appears at MULTIPLE touchpoints (registration, checkout, download, favorites). Clients can opt in (or not) at each separately, not once globally.
Mobile Gallery App image cap at 200 forces curation, which can be positioned as an editorial decision rather than a technical limitation.
Contact type conversion is automatic: an inquiry Lead who books becomes a Client in Studio Manager without manual reclassification.
contradictions: Watermark default framing: documentation initially implies watermarks apply broadly to web downloads, but the actual default is configurable and watermarks are never on high-res/print. Initial read can mislead into thinking watermarks are always on.
notes: Source is Pixieset's own Help Center documentation. No strategic doctrine, brand positioning, or customer psychology. Operational reference only. Use when configuring the SNIPED delivery and commerce stack: gallery setup, print lab selection, shipping configuration, tax setup, Studio Manager booking workflow, and client contact automation.
